blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Residents across the Visayas face potentially dangerous heat conditions on Monday as the heat index could reach 45 degrees Celsius in parts of the region. Meanwhile, Cebu could experience a heat index of 38 degrees Celsius through Tuesday, Nov. 17. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) warned that prolonged exposure to these conditions could cause heat cramps, heat exhaustion and heat stroke, particularly among people who spend extended periods outdoors.
